items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You're a Scorpio. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, right. How did you know?

ctx.x: Well, Buddy wouldn't let me go. (Unintelligible) but not since Buddy's dead. Buddy's been dead five years now. So now, if everybody's going to go, I don't mind going. (Unintelligible).
Yeah, right. How did you know?
